title: trade_diagnostics
description: Per-trade and summary diagnostics produced by run_protocol.py alongside protocol_summary.json. Step 03 artifact.

trades.description: One record per closed trade across all walk-forward windows.

realized_return.description: Gross return as % of position value (denominator: entry_price). Used for MAE/MFE ratio and entry/exit_efficiency comparisons.

profitable_net.description: True when net-of-commission return > 0. Matches the engine's PerformanceTracker definition. Use this for win classification, not realized_return > 0.

net_portfolio_return_pct.description: Net return as % of total portfolio value (after commission). Use this for per_trade_expectancy_bps, not position-level gross.

mae.description: Max adverse excursion as positive % of entry price during holding window

mfe.description: Max favorable excursion as positive % of entry price during holding window

entry_efficiency.description: realized_return minus hypothetical return if entered at next-bar open. Positive = early entry was better.

exit_efficiency.description: Fraction of best possible return captured (hindsight optimum). Valid only for relative comparison — not achievable headroom (A3.3).

post_exit_return_5bars.description: A3.1: signed return in position direction for 5 bars after exit. Required for stop_loss_recovery_rate.

post_exit_return_20bars.description: A3.1: signed return in position direction for 20 bars after exit.

cost_paid.description: A3.2: round-trip cost in bps. From config/cost_model.yaml if available; else from actual commission data.

summary.description: Aggregated trade-level statistics across all windows and symbols.

win_rate_net.description: Net-of-commission win rate (% of trades with profitable_net = true). Matches engine's own win_rate. Note: gross win rate overstates this by ~8pp at 0.2% commission.

mae_mfe_ratio_median.description: Median of (MAE/MFE) per trade. High ratio + low realized return = exits leaving money on table.

entry_efficiency_median.description: Median entry_efficiency. Near 0 = entry timing adds nothing; negative = late/early entry degrades edge.

exit_efficiency_median.description: Median exit_efficiency. Hindsight benchmark — see A3.3 caveat.

pct_pnl_from_top_decile_trades.description: % of total PnL from the top 10% of trades by return. High value = fragile tail-dependency on winners.

pct_pnl_from_worst_decile_trades.description: % of total PnL from the worst 10% of trades. When this exceeds 100% (in magnitude), the worst few trades wipe out all gains — confirms uncapped loss tail. Key input for holding_sizing diagnosis.

stop_loss_recovery_rate.description: A3.1: fraction of stop_loss exits where post_exit_return_20bars > 0. Triggers holding_sizing diagnosis when above threshold.

per_trade_expectancy_bps.description: A3.4: primary performance stat when median_sharpe is invalid (> 50% sparse windows). Computed from net_portfolio_return_pct * 100 (portfolio-level net bps), NOT position-level gross. Matches engine's PerformanceTracker records.

zero_trade_slot_pct.description: A3.4: % of all window-symbol slots with 0 trades. > 30% is a deployment risk independent of expectancy.

fee_reduction_metrics.description: E-016 (fee-reduction autopsy field): 2 diagnostic metrics per timing-only lever (4 levers), feeding verdict_interpreter's fee_reduction_assessment.candidate_system decision when a kill is cost-dominated (post_backtest_route_real == kill_cost_hurdle/refine_cost_hurdle). null when no fee_reduction_metrics were computed (mirrors 'summary' itself being absent when there are no trades).

lookback_bars.description: N: the shared lookback/lookahead bar count used by every metric below. See run_protocol.py::_FEE_REDUCTION_LOOKAHEAD_BARS for the current value and rationale.

same_direction_reentry_rate.description: Fraction of consecutive same-symbol trade pairs (within one walk-forward window) that are same-direction and re-enter within lookback_bars of the prior trade's exit.

avg_reentry_gap_bars.description: Average gap in bars between such qualifying re-entries.

avg_post_exit_drift_pct.description: Mean of (price lookback_bars after exit - exit price) / exit price, sign-adjusted so positive = favorable (the position would have kept gaining had it stayed open).

pct_better_exit_1bar_later.description: % of trades where holding exactly 1 more bar would have given a better exit price than the actual exit.

avg_pre_entry_drift_pct.description: Mean of (entry price - price lookback_bars before entry) / price lookback_bars before entry, sign-adjusted so positive = favorable (toward the trade's eventual direction).

pct_better_entry_1bar_earlier.description: % of trades where entering exactly 1 bar earlier would have given a better entry price.

boundary_recross_rate.description: How often the forecast re-crosses its boundary level (threshold_filter's min_abs if configured, else the zero-crossing) within lookback_bars of its last crossing of that same level. High = whipsaw.

frequency_vs_volatility_ratio.description: trades per day / realized price volatility over the same window. Distinguishes genuine market volatility from a real whipsaw inefficiency.

realized_edge_to_cost_ratio.description: CUL-300: mean gross (pre-commission) edge per trade in bps (from realized_return) divided by mean round-trip cost per trade in bps (cost_paid, A3.2). Null when mean cost is exactly 0 (guarded, not inf/nan). Addressable input for a future, separately-owned pass/fail criterion -- this field does not itself decide promote/kill. UNDER-COMPLETE for perpetuals held across a funding settlement until E-053 (sub-daily funding accrual) lands -- see cost_components_measured.

cost_components_measured.description: CUL-300: which cost components are actually itemized in the trade records this run measured, determined by inspection rather than assumed.
